title: Plan
goal: You post your work on your own profile, share the link, and invite people

phases.title: 1 · Decide
phases.sub: This week. Everything else waits on the name.

tasks.text: Plan copied into the project folder + this page
Buy the domain on Cloudflare after your yes
Brand kit: logo, colors, fonts, brand.json
PRODUCT.md + DESIGN.md, like our other repos

phases.title: 2 · Set up
phases.sub: Day 1 after the name. Runs on what we already have.

tasks.text: GitHub repo + checks on every push

phases.title: 3 · Your profile live
phases.sub: Days 1-3. You post, share a link.

tasks.text: Sign up + log in (our own accounts, passkeys)
Upload photo or video to our storage, with proof of who made it
Public profile page with link previews
Bring in your old posts automatically (Instagram export)

decisions.why: Every real-word .com is taken. .social reads as a network; .org says nonprofit. Handles can be roy.<domain>.
A web page is the fastest thing you can share as a link. The phone app reuses the same code later.
Bluesky login works today and brings their followers. Our own accounts come when we run our own server.

decisions.q: Where do photos live at first?
decisions.why: In the person's own Bluesky storage costs us $0 and they can leave with it. Our storage (R2) adds speed later.
Contributors need it public. A rename later keeps old links working.
Every creator. AI copies video, music, designs and objects now.

decisions.q: Where do we watch for copies first?
decisions.why: Where art theft is loudest today.

decisions.q: Who owns it at the start?
decisions.why: A nonprofit takes months to form. Start under the LLC, move to a nonprofit host at beta.

names.note: Prices from Cloudflare Registrar (10:54). Name clash = existing apps/brands found.

items.name: madeby
items.why: Every profile reads "made by you": madeby.social/@roy. Proof of who made it, in the name.

items.name: Shown Here
items.why: Where your work is shown first. The only name with .com free.

items.name: Firstframe
items.why: The first frame is the original. Hints at provenance.

items.name: Kindframe
items.why: Kind place, your frame. Every ending but .com free.

items.name: Open Porch
items.why: Sit out front, show what you made, say hi.

items.name: Courtyard
items.why: The open middle of the house where people gather. Hotel brand shares it (harder SEO).

items.name: Lightbox
items.why: What photographers view their work on. Common word, harder to rank.

items.name: Ownframe
items.why: You own your frame, and you can leave with it.

items.name: Sharekeep
items.why: Share it, keep it yours.

items.name: Showfolk
items.why: The people who show their work.

items.name: Hearthside
items.why: Warm, by the fire, among friends.

items.name: Framekin
items.why: Your people, around your pictures.

items.name: Shotby
items.why: 'Shot by <you>' is the photographer credit line, so every post is a signature

items.name: Signedframe
items.why: Signed + frame = every post is signed

items.name: Folioproof
items.why: 'folio' catches the portfolio searches, 'proof' says your work is signed
items.phrase: portfolio for artists + proof of authorship

items.name: Ownshot
items.why: 'Your own shot' = ownership + authorship, welcoming not hostile
items.phrase: protect my photos from being stolen

items.name: Stillproof
items.why: 'Still' = a photograph
items.phrase: prove I took this photo / content credentials

items.name: Frameproof
items.why: Frame = photo, proof = verified
items.phrase: protect my photos from being stolen

items.name: Drawnby
items.why: 'Drawn by <you>' is the illustrator credit

items.name: Inkedby
items.why: 'Inked by <artist>' is how clients tag tattoo work

items.name: Whomade
items.why: Answers the question every stolen-art repost raises: who made this
items.phrase: prove I took this photo / content credentials

items.name: Atproof
items.why: AT Protocol + proof
items.phrase: bluesky photo app / AT Protocol proof

items.name: Hallmarked
items.why: A hallmark is the maker's stamp on silver
items.phrase: content credentials / proof of who made it

items.name: Truemade
items.why: 'Authentic photo' has autocomplete demand

items.name: Fair
items.why: Credit, pay and reach, all fair. One syllable, a stance.
items.conflictWhy: Generic word; near-homophone Faire (big wholesale marketplace); FairMoney; Fair VPN; Equal/other 'fair' creator networks in web search

items.name: Firsthand
items.why: Made by a human hand, the original, an honest account.
items.check: $410 first yr, then $70 · name clash: minor
items.conflictWhy: No creator/AI product found by that name; App Store has small apps (Firsthand: To-Do Cards, First Hand: Secret Shopper, Firsthand for Business)

items.name: Credit
items.why: Every piece carries its maker. Bold, but the money meaning competes.
items.conflictWhy: Credit scores/cards own the word (Experian, Credit Karma, Capital One CreditWise, Credit Sesame); no creator product by the name

items.name: Honestly
items.why: How friends talk. No bots, no bought reach.
items.conflictWhy: Small apps: Honestly: Journal & Reflect, Honestly, Honestly Engage; Honestly analytics tool on Product Hunt; no major social/creator brand

items.name: Sincerely
items.why: The sign-off on a letter: warm, and it's your signature.
items.check: $910 first yr, then $70 · name clash: serious
items.conflictWhy: Sincerely: Vent & Confess (MWM, anonymous social app, exact name); Sincerely Inc is a known photo-print/gift app company [inferred from memory, not verified this run]

items.name: Sigil
items.stance: Your mark on everything you make.
items.why: A maker's mark with some magic to it.
items.check: $910 first yr, then $70 · name clash: minor
items.conflictWhy: Sigil Video (social video app) discontinued; Sigil Creator / SigilAI / Sigil Maker occult apps; Sigil EPUB editor; Project: Sigil social idea on DEV; nothing big

items.name: Here
items.why: Tiny and present. Hard to search for.
items.conflictWhy: HERE Technologies / HERE WeGo maps is a major brand; several apps named Here (subway, peer support, TV, puzzle); word is ungoogleable

items.name: Byline
items.stance: Your name stays on your work.
items.why: The credit line on every story, for every medium.
items.conflictWhy: Byline Bank (large US bank, finance); Byline multiplayer writing app; Byline Times / Byline magazine; Byline: Reads; none are creator networks

items.name: Ours
items.stance: Owned by the people on it.
items.why: Nonprofit, and your work stays yours.
items.check: $910 first yr, then $70 · name clash: serious
items.conflictWhy: Several exact-name photo/memory/art apps: Ours: Wedding & Event Camera, Ours: Couple Diary, Ours: Couple Widget & Art, Ours - Shared Memories; Oura near-homophone

items.name: Vow
items.why: A promise you keep: credit, protection, no tricks.
items.check: $910 first yr, then $70 · name clash: minor
items.conflictWhy: Many small exact-name apps (VOW habit/urge blockers, Vow Wedding AI planner, Vow Affirmations); none in creator/social space

items.name: Chorus
items.why: Many makers, one place. Lifts everyone, not a few.
items.check: $910 first yr, then $70 · name clash: serious
items.conflictWhy: Chorus - The Future is Fandom (fan platform for artists, same space); Chorus Network (music distribution app); Chorus by ZoomInfo; Chorus nonprofit for civic creators (wearechorus.com, nonprofit + creators overlap)

items.name: Witness
items.why: We witness who made it first. Heavier tone.
items.conflictWhy: WITNESS (witness.org, human rights nonprofit, leading voice on media provenance/C2PA); Witness app by Reel Human signs photos/videos at capture (direct overlap); Witness: Camera Beyond Reach
